import os
base='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs'; os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
p=base+'/task-2d347ec0.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in pts); r1=max(y for y,x in pts)
            c0=min(x for y,x in pts); c1=max(x for y,x in pts)
            layers=[]
            for y,x in pts:
                d=min(y-r0,r1-y,x-c0,c1-x)
                col=grid[y][x]
                if d>=len(layers): layers.extend([None]*(d+1-len(layers)))
                if layers[d] is None: layers[d]=col
            cols=[v for v in layers if v is not None]
            mapping={a:b for a,b in zip(cols,reversed(cols))}
            for y,x in pts: out[y][x]=mapping[grid[y][x]]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
